# Expertise Reversal Effect

A finding from Kalyuga et al. (2003): detailed instructional guidance given to experts causes them to perform **worse** than beginners given the same guidance.

Implication for interviewing: don't over-explain basics to senior interviewers. See [[Career Positioning]].
